FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Harvest Market
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Fresh Harvest Market, we specialize in providing a wide variety of fresh fruits and vegetables, sourced from local farms and trusted suppliers. Our operations prioritize quality, adhering to strict regulations set by local health departments. We maintain temperature and humidity controls for all perishable inventory to ensure freshness. Our dedicated team undergoes regular training in handling protocols, which is essential for minimizing risks. Additionally, we conduct thorough supplier audits to ensure compliance with standards. With a focus on sustainability, we are committed to using eco-friendly practices and reducing waste in our operations. We believe that by prioritizing quality, we provide our community with the best produce available.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, we experienced a loss of $1,000 due to a power outage that affected our refrigeration units, resulting in spoilage of perishable inventory. This incident has been resolved, and we have since implemented backup power systems to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard security safe, Class B, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the premises, monitored by on-site watchpersons during operating hours to enhance safety and deter theft.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations focus solely on the sale of fresh fruits and vegetables, adhering to food safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not sponsor athletic teams; our focus is primarily on providing fresh produce and ensuring food safety within our operations.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The Quality Control Manager checks all certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Fresh Harvest Market has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We prioritize integrity and compliance in all aspects of our operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Harvest Market has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior 3 years. Our current coverage is in good standing.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not lease employees to or from other employers; we maintain our own staff to ensure quality and consistency in our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not currently carry Workers' Compensation. We maintain our own staff and prioritize safety and compliance in all aspects of our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fresh Harvest Market also owns and operates Fresh Harvest Organic Produce Co., allowing us to offer a broader range of quality produce to our customers.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We currently hold the policy FH2023-VG897 exclusively for our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Harvest Market is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the retail sale of fresh fruits and vegetables.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on the sale of fresh fruits and vegetables. Providing equipment rental is outside the scope of our business activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Harvest Market has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial standing remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals. Our operations primarily involve the retail sale of fresh fruits and vegetables, with a strong emphasis on food safety and quality.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Harvest Market does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are solely focused on the sale of fresh fruits and vegetables, with strong food safety practices in place.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Harvest Market has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize safety and compliance with all applicable regulations, fostering a positive work environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Harvest Market currently has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all fire safety regulations.
